title: 第11章 第二案：水泥藏尸（4）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

念念的小雷达立马警铃大作。

拿出自己的笔记本一看。

仰头就对李安国说道：“他不是凶手。”

李安国微愣，“这也是你听……额，感觉出来的？”

念念脑袋有些晕乎。

什么感觉不感觉？

感觉是什么？

她掏出自己随身携带的笔记本，指着上面某处说到：“是念念记下来的！”

李安国看着笔记本上的鬼画符。

仔细辨认。

“这是……两个人？”

“嗯呐！”念念点头，眼神期待的看着李安国。

李安国额头冒汗。

大脑疯狂运转。

两个人……两个人站在一起手牵手。

左边的人好像比右边的高一些？

“他们关系很好？”

“嗯嗯，还有呢？”念念更兴奋了！

果然最懂她的人是爸爸！

任曼妮好奇看了一眼。

默默撤回一个脑袋。

李队不愧是李队。

念念随手画的几根线，都能观察出这么多信息。

果然姜还是老的辣！

ദ്ദി˶•̀֊•́)✧

李安国欲哭无泪。

为了解读念念这画，他连刑侦经验都用上了。

但他是真看不出更多了啊！

为了不让念念失望。

李安国硬着头皮猜测道：“左边这人年纪比右边的大？”

(☆▽☆)

念念眼睛更亮了！

宛若天上的星辰。

无比崇拜的看着爸爸。

“爸爸你好厉害！曼妮阿姨都看不出来！还问我画的是不是小青蛙，哼！”

李安国得了念念夸奖，顿时宛若一只斗胜的公鸡。

抬头挺胸，眼神睥睨的看了任曼妮一眼。

虽然一个字没说，但任曼妮总觉得有人在她耳边说了五个字：“无能的女人。”

(╯‵皿′)╯︵┻━┻

三人回到警局。

李安国安排人去联系建筑公司王董，约定见面时间。

原以为王董会和他之前打交道的那些有钱人一样。

直接拒绝见面。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Nian Nian's little radar immediately went off.

Take out your notebook and take a look.

He raised his head and said to Li Anguo: "He is not a murderer."

Li Anguo was slightly stunned, "Is this what you heard... um, felt?"

Nian Nian's head felt a little dizzy.

What does it feel like not to feel?

What does it feel like?

She took out the notebook she carried with her, pointed to somewhere on it and said, "Nian Nian wrote it down!"

Li Anguo looked at the ghost drawing symbols on his notebook.

Identify carefully.

"These are... two people?"

"Yeah!" Nian Nian nodded, looking at Li Anguo expectantly.

Li Anguo was sweating on his forehead.

The brain is working like crazy.

Two people... two people standing together holding hands.

The person on the left seems to be taller than the one on the right?

"They have a good relationship?"

"Yeah, what else?" Niannian was even more excited!

Sure enough, the person who understands her best is her father!

Ren Manni took a curious look.

Silently withdrawing one head.

Team Lee deserves to be Team Lee.

So much information can be observed from just a few lines drawn by Nian Nian.

Sure enough, ginger is still spicy!

ദ്ദി˶•̀֊•́)✧

Li Anguo wanted to cry but had no tears.

In order to interpret Nian Nian's painting, he even used his criminal investigation experience.

But he really couldn’t see any more!

In order not to disappoint Niannian.

Li Anguo bravely guessed: "The person on the left is older than the one on the right?"

(☆▽☆)

Niannian’s eyes are brighter!

Like stars in the sky.

Looking at dad with great admiration.

"Dad, you are so awesome! Aunt Manny can't even see it! She even asked me if what I drew was a little frog, hum!"

Li Anguo was praised by Nian Nian, and he suddenly felt like a victorious rooster.

He raised his head and chest, and glanced at Ren Manni with a stern look.

Although she didn't say a word, Ren Manni always felt like someone said five words in her ear: "Incompetent woman."

(╯‵Van′)╯︵┻━┻

The three returned to the police station.

Li Anguo arranged for someone to contact Director Wang of the construction company and agreed on a meeting time.

I thought Director Wang was just like the rich people he had dealt with before.

Refuse to meet directly.
